responsibility: This definition module exposes mc’s optional C-preprocessing hook. It defines the single service that preprocesses a source file when requested and returns either the original filename or the temporary preprocessed filename, abstracting away command construction and temporary-file lifetime management from the compilation driver.
same_name_distinction: This .def file provides the single exported declaration for the mcPreprocess service, abstracting preprocessing behind one procedure signature; mcPreprocess.mod implements command construction, temporary-file tracking, process execution, and cleanup registration.
